title: tares factory roster --json: the running stations

orchestrator.description: The station name messages to the orchestrator go to.

project.description: The project id; empty for a station that serves all projects.

turn.description: Whose turn the session is on, as Claude Code says it; `gone` when it has no live session.

claude_code.description: The Claude Code version the station runs; says `(older than X)` when it is behind the installed one. Empty for a station on another runtime.

runtime.description: What runs the station, when it is not Claude Code: `codex`. Absent for a station on Claude Code.

codex.description: The Codex version a station on Codex was started on; absent for a station on Claude Code.
